payload.objective: Submit Phase 1 Database & Schema Alignment completion report and request Phase 2 Task Dispatch.
payload.explicit_request: Phase 1 Database Alignment is complete with all 4 migrations reconciled and 163 tests passing. Please evaluate and issue TASK_DISPATCH for Phase 2 (R26 Practicum & Basic Science Workspace).

task_report.summary: All 4 legacy database migrations successfully ported, linted, and verified with 163 tests passing.

payload.reason: Phase 1 is accepted as complete. The report establishes that all four audited schema gaps were reconciled, the existing 112 migration files were preserved, the resulting migration count is 116, all four migration files pass PHP syntax validation, and the full regression suite passes with 163 tests and 960 assertions. This provides the required schema foundation for the subsequent reconciliation work. Phase 2 is therefore authorized. The implementation must not copy the 7,366-line legacy Basic Science view directly: it must be decomposed into modular Blade partials and mounted within the mandated CampusLynk workspace shell. The audit specifically identifies the missing Basic Science workspace and the omitted Table 2.2/Table 3.1 debounced inline-autosave behavior as functional gaps, while also identifying R26 Theory SBTE grade scaling and lesson-plan deletion as additional reconciliation items. Phase 2 should restore those behaviors while preserving the existing CampusLynk architecture and avoiding duplication.
